verdict.rationale: Nix is software you install and run on your own infrastructure. The docs give a multi-user install script for Linux and macOS, installation of NixOS on physical hardware, an official EC2 AMI, and an official Docker image, so users can host the core product themselves. Missing for 10: no evidence of the source license or that the code is openly available, and no documentation for self-hosting the binary cache that serves pre-built packages.
